meta.name: firecrawl-agent
meta.description: AI-powered autonomous data extraction that navigates complex sites and returns structured JSON. Use this skill when the user wants structured data from websites, needs to extract pricing tiers, product listings, directory entries, or any data as JSON with a schema. Triggers on "extract structured data", "get all the products", "pull pricing info", "extract as JSON", or when the user provides a JSON schema for website data. More powerful than simple scraping for multi-page structured extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从复杂网站提取结构化JSON数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从多页网站自动提取结构化数据为JSON格式
copy.tagline_en: Extract structured JSON data from complex websites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically extract structured data from multi-page websites as JSON

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能自动浏览复杂网站，提取你需要的结构化数据（如价格、产品列表），并输出为 JSON 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求提取网站上的结构化数据，比如“提取所有产品”、“获取定价信息”，或者你提供了 JSON 数据格式时触发。

say.text: 帮我提取这个网站的所有产品名称和价格。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can autonomously navigate complex websites, extract structured data (e.g., pricing, product listings), and output it as a JSON file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to extract structured data from websites, such as "extract all products", "get pricing info", or when you provide a JSON schema.

say_en.text: Extract all product names and prices from this website.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the Firecrawl agent and return JSON results.

say_en.text: Extract data using this JSON schema: {"name":"string","price":"number"}.
say_en.note: Claude will output structured data according to your schema.
